cateringDialog.title: Meal & drink vouchers
cateringDialog.emptyDescription: No digital vouchers are configured for this event or your shift has not been activated yet.

tokenCard.redeemConfirmDescription: Only redeem this voucher directly at the counter in front of staff. Redeemed vouchers cannot be restored.

calendarDialog.title: Subscribe to shifts in your calendar
calendarDialog.resetWarningText: Your old calendar link was deactivated for security reasons. Please <bold>first remove the old calendar subscription</bold> in your calendar app before adding the new link below.
calendarDialog.intro: Subscribe to all your shifts directly in your calendar app. Future shifts, schedule changes, or signoffs sync <bold>automatically</bold> in the background.
calendarDialog.googleDescription: Directly opens Google Calendar with your personal subscription. Just click "Add" there.
calendarDialog.copySuccessDesc: Paste the link into Google Calendar or your calendar app.
calendarDialog.appleDescription: Opens the Calendar app on Apple devices and sets up the subscription with one click.
calendarDialog.outlookDescription: Opens Outlook on the web with your personal calendar subscription.

calendarDialog.resetLinkDescription: If your calendar link was compromised, you can revoke it here and generate a new one.

calendarDialog.outlookDescriptionDetailed: For Outlook in the browser or on PC/Mac.
calendarDialog.otherCalendarDescriptionDetailed: Supports any calendar app with iCal/Webcal subscription (e.g. Thunderbird, Fantastical).
calendarDialog.noSubDescription: Download a one-time .ics calendar file of all current shifts. (Does not update automatically).

calendarDialog.manualGoogleStep4: Select <bold>"From URL"</bold> and paste the copied link.
